* '''Playtest''' ([[Tracked Fleet (Playtest)]]): Playtest image: PC card image of 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-tf-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/7821822/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/trackedfleet.gif trackedfleet.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/7821822 7821822] (7 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. Supremacy moves to here for free. There Will Be No Surrender: Three times per game, at start of opponent's move phase, opponent may stack a card from hand face down on this card to relocate it to another system within 3 parsecs. Fire At Will!: At the start of your turn, if you control this system, Tracked Fleet is 'annihilated' (placed out of play).”
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image of 8 August 2025<ref name="ht-tf-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d996b0/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/trackedfleet.gif trackedfleet.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/9d996b0 9d996b0] (8 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: “relocate it to another system” becomes “relocate it to an [Episode VII] system”. The same text is printed on the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF built 10 August 2025, page 3). Text: “Deploy on D'Qar system (only at start of game). Tied To The End Of A String: You may not deploy starships here. Supremacy moves to here for free. There Will Be No Surrender: Three times per game, at start of opponent's move phase, opponent may stack a card from hand face down on this card to relocate it to an [Episode VII] system within 3 parsecs. Fire At Will!: At the start of your turn, if you control this system, Tracked Fleet is 'annihilated' (placed out of play).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tracked Fleet (Errata)]]): PC card image of 11 May 2026<ref name="ht-tf-2">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/bdead15/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/trackedfleet.gif trackedfleet.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/bdead15 bdead15] (11 May 2026).</ref>, marked “E1”. What changed from the previous image: PC May 2026 errata (marked “E1”): “(or from top of Lost Pile)” added after “stack a card from hand” in There Will Be No Surrender. Text: “Deploy on D'Qar system (only at start of game). Tied To The End Of A String: You may not deploy starships here. Supremacy moves to here for free. There Will Be No Surrender: Three times per game, at start of opponent's move phase, opponent may stack a card from hand (or from top of Lost Pile) face down on this card to relocate it to an [Episode VII] system within 3 parsecs. Fire At Will!: At the start of your turn, if you control this system, Tracked Fleet is 'annihilated' (placed out of play).”
